name: golem-night-watch
description: Runs the skeptic overnight and posts a summary of the proposals it wrote.
author: golem

schedule.prompt: Run once. Use the golem-skeptic agent: call list_requirements, then falsify on the requirements that held at their last run with a budget of 64 trials, and propose a harsher believable line for each requirement you can break. Submit proposals only with propose_requirement; never create, modify or delete a requirements file or a file under controller/. When you finish, post a summary that lists: the number of proposals written and their requirement ids; the ids of the requirements whose latest verdict is broken; and the budget used as the number of trials run and the wall time in seconds. If the run fails before it completes, post a summary that states the failure and the number of proposals written before it, and leave every requirements file and controller file unchanged.
